evals.prompt: I have a design doc at `.ai/spec/initial-design.md` that describes a Go adapter component for bridging OpenShift alerts into an agentic system. Break it down into implementation tasks and save them to `.ai/tasks/`.
evals.expected_output: A series of numbered markdown task files in .ai/tasks/ covering project scaffolding, AlertManager client, Proposal builder, naming/sanitization, poll loop, health probes, deployment manifests, and RBAC. Tasks should be ordered so each builds on prior ones. The skill should not create tasks for items listed under Future Work.

evals.prompt: Here's a design doc at `implementation-planner/evals/test-design-vague-cli.md` for a Python CLI tool. Please create implementation tasks in `/tmp/logparse-tasks/`.

evals.prompt: I have a small design doc at `implementation-planner/evals/test-design-healthcheck.md` for a Go health check library. Generate implementation tasks in `/tmp/healthcheck-tasks/`.
